data.body_html:
September 2028 is arguably the best month for a Marbella boat rental. The summer heat has mellowed, the sea is still bath-warm at 24°C, and the crowds have thinned. This shoulder-season guide covers everything you need to know about Marbella boat rental weather September 2028 – from temperatures and wind to the best boats and itineraries.

September Weather Averages for Marbella

Marbella enjoys a Mediterranean climate with 300+ sunny days a year. In September, you can expect average highs of 26°C and lows of 19°C. Sea surface temperature holds steady at 24°C, making it ideal for swimming. Prevailing winds are light offshore at 5–10 knots, so seas are calm. Rainfall is minimal – typically 2–3 days with brief showers. UV index is still high (6–7), so bring sunscreen.

Why September Is Prime Time for Your Charter

Booking a boat rental in Marbella in September means you avoid the peak-season rush. Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina are less crowded, anchorages are quieter, and you often get more personalised service from your skipper. The longer daylight hours (sunset around 20:30) allow for extended sunset cruises. Plus, availability is better – you can often secure a boat with just a few weeks' notice.

Best Boats for September Conditions

With calm seas and warm weather, almost any vessel works. For a group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers ample deck space and a free jet ski. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) is another favourite for its shaded flybridge and sun pads. Smaller parties can opt for the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749 for 2 hours or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at the same rate. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

Pricing and Inclusions for September Charters

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours – that includes skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, with a free jet ski included. For other vessels (e.g. Ferretti 94, Pershing 46, Lagoon 380), pricing is available on request via WhatsApp – just ask.

Top September Itineraries from Puerto Banús

Depart from Puerto Banús and head east towards Marbella Marina and La Concha mountain views. Alternatively, cruise west to Estepona and Sotogrande for quieter coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. For a full-day trip, consider Cabopino – a hidden gem with crystal-clear water. The light winds make all routes comfortable. Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences.

What to Pack for a September Boat Trip

Pack swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (SPF 50+), sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket or jumper for the evening. A camera is essential for the golden-hour light. All our charters provide water, soft drinks, beer, wine, and snacks – but you're welcome to bring your own food. We recommend booking a Marbella boat rental with a sunset slot to make the most of the long evenings.

Book Your September 2028 Charter Today

Don't wait until the last minute – while September is quieter, the best boats still get snapped up. Browse our full fleet and check availability via WhatsApp. Whether you want a 2-hour spin or a full-day luxury cruise, we'll match you with the perfect vessel. Start planning your Marbella boat rental now for an unforgettable September on the Mediterranean.

Frequently asked questions

Is September a good month for a boat rental in Marbella?

Yes, September is one of the best months. The sea is still warm from summer, and the air temperatures are pleasant. The summer crowds have thinned, so you'll find more availability and quieter anchorages. It's a sweet spot for a relaxed charter.

What is the sea temperature in Marbella in September 2028?

The Mediterranean sea temperature around Marbella averages 24°C in September. This is comfortable for swimming, snorkelling, and water sports without a wetsuit. The water stays warm well into the evening.

Will I need a jacket or jumper for a September boat trip?

During the day, light clothing is fine. Evenings can be cooler, especially on the water, so a light jacket or jumper is advisable for sunset cruises. The average low is 19°C, but wind chill can make it feel cooler.

What are the typical wind conditions in September?

September usually brings light offshore winds of 5–10 knots, making for calm seas. The Levante wind is less frequent than in spring. It's a great month for a smooth ride, whether you're on a motor yacht or a sailing catamaran.

Does it rain much in Marbella in September?

Rain is uncommon in September, with only 2–3 wet days on average. Showers are usually brief and don't affect full-day charters. The sun dominates, so you can confidently plan a trip without worrying about washouts.

Which boat is best for a September charter in Marbella?

For a group up to 12, the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer plenty of deck space and sun protection. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are excellent value. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

How far in advance should I book a September boat rental?

While September is less frantic than August, popular boats like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 still book up. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead to secure your preferred vessel and time slot.

What are the best anchorages in September?

Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are top spots for calm swimming. The coast between Marbella and Estepona offers sheltered coves. Later in the day, head towards Cabopino for a quieter vibe. The sea is usually flat enough for all anchorages.
